activity_summary: At dinner you paid threepence. You told the house that Venus will be printed again, smaller, with not a penny in it for you, and that you were glad to be thought portable. Two quires at fourpence halfpenny are to be laid by, and you did not pay. You left the Sunday letter folded for tomorrow. You still had no newer word than mending.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the octavo as news, left the paper unpaid, and refused to rewrite the letter.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Took threepence, kept ninepence unpaid from becoming ninepence spent, and left her old ruling on the comedy where it was.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Did the ninepence once, and offered to set the letter by his cloak without opening it.

entities.name: Venus and Adonis
entities.context: Mentioned in Glad to be thought portable

facets.activity: Reported a smaller Venus and kept the letter folded

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I told him I was glad to be thought portable.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not pay an intention.
